considerations.sourcePassage: So there's a lot of changes that occur
considerations.reason: The rewrite renders this as 'Many changes therefore occur'. While 'therefore' adds an inferential connective, in context it simply summarizes the preceding discussion of genetic, epigenetic, and viral changes without introducing an unsupported factual claim.

considerations.sourcePassage: There are about seven different human viruses that will precipitate cancer, and they can also predispose to chronic inflammatory events that can also help to give rise to cancer.
considerations.reason: The rewrite changes 'they' to 'infection' ('and infection can also predispose to chronic inflammatory events'). This minor shift in phrasing maintains the same overall biological meaning.
